findings.summary: cython_generate --validate rejects the repository's generated Annoy Cython source because legitimate doubled braces in CSS/JavaScript are mistaken for unprocessed Tempita markers.
cython_generate documents atomic output, but process_template writes the final file directly with Path.write_text rather than staging and replacing it.

gitversion.add_safe_directory error paths reference exception variable e after its except scope (and from a ValueError handler that binds ve), causing UnboundLocalError instead of the documented fallback result.
git_version retries any git return code 128 by globally adding the _build_utils subdirectory as safe.directory; this is persistent user Git configuration and is not the repository root.

install_meson_features._needs_update relies on source-vs-destination mtimes and source names only, so content drift with newer destination timestamps and stale destination-only files can be accepted as up to date.
copy_file fails for an ordinary destination filename in the current directory because os.path.dirname(dest) is empty and os.makedirs("") raises FileNotFoundError.
test_gitversion imports the production git-version APIs but never calls them; its green tests mostly re-simulate expected behavior and therefore miss the real error-path defects.
